analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and metadata, including the bounded Placement patch. No independently supported exploitable regression is established in this scope. AutopilotControl.swift:19,55 now uses the expanded cached model set; consent/private-only, revision, pause and bounded lease checks remain (:109-114). AutopilotDownload.swift:45-84 adds coordinator-triggered downloads under saved consent and provider settings. Publication rechecks consent/pause, eligibility, self-tests and resident/loading ownership (:132-157), then updates hashes and capacity without directly advertising. Inventory.swift:15 preserves adopted advertisements after lease loss; :62-85 retains load ownership and reserve checks. ModelSet.swift:13-55 expands reported selection without changing consent revision; :81-105 verifies cached candidates asynchronously; :111-158 adds idle planned reconnects. Relevant boundaries/assets are TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, A-004 and A-016; model integrity and availability relate to T-012, T-027, T-016 and T-029, and reconnect authorization to T-053. No supplied change directly alters encryption, prompt exposure, billing, Apple proof verification, fan authority or T-041 cache cryptography/scoping.
Integration must verify the new prefetcher's catalog/hash validation, disk-reserve enforcement and concurrent budget accounting. Download.swift:25-29 derives caps from a persistent ledger, but :174-179 allows absent or failed persistence; determine whether accounting remains bounded when records cannot be written or publication is refused. Also reconcile live disable semantics: admission checks downloads.enabled (:49), publication checks consent/pause but not that setting (:132-135). Verify candidate rule integrity checks at ModelSet.swift:94, expanded-selection consent semantics, and planned reconnect invalidation of serving grants. Placement source is metadata/bounded patch only: its visible basis checks include consent, membership, residency, self-test and live hash, but adoption/hold lifecycle and occurrence binding remain unverified. These are material integration contracts, not proven vulnerabilities.
